upstream.notes: Vendored in-tree from Kai's fork. The fix branch carries one unreleased commit on top of 0.2.1 (surface real compiler errors in `script run`). Maintained alongside the RH850 analysis work.

downstream_patches.summary: Agent-ergonomics patches applied in-tree after vendoring. Not upstream.
changes: Structured error protocol: BridgeError{code,message,diagnostics}, CommandError type, JSON stderr rendering in JSON mode
Batch fix: shlex parsing, fail-fast default, --continue-on-error, JSON array input with token-vector preservation
Durable save: program save --message, stop --save, script run --save, bridge handleProgramSave
Compound inspect command: single bridge-side atomic job (decompile+xrefs+callers+callees+disasm+metadata)
Script check: compile-only Java script via handleScriptCheck (no execute())
Enriched bridge status: dirty/last_modified/active_transaction/queued_job_count via volatile snapshots (thread-safe)
Structured errorResponse(code, message, diagnostics) overload in Java bridge
executeProgramRequest: pass-through for pre-formed structured wire responses
